passages.text: For our history project, I interview Grandpa about his old kitchen. In a photo, a pipe supplies natural gas to the kitchen cooker. I ask if everyone in his generation cooked in the same way. He laughs and shows a neighbour's photo with a very different stove. We choose both photos instead of writing one simple rule about all older people. Before finishing, we add names and dates under the pictures. Our page shows that people of a similar age can still have different lives.

parallelText.en: For our history project, I interview Grandpa about his old kitchen.
parallelText.zh: 为了完成历史课题，我采访爷爷，了解他以前的厨房。

parallelText.en: In a photo, a pipe supplies natural gas to the kitchen cooker.
parallelText.zh: 照片里，一根管道给厨房灶具输送天然气。

parallelText.en: I ask if everyone in his generation cooked in the same way.
parallelText.zh: 我问，他那一代人是不是都以同样的方式做饭。

parallelText.en: He laughs and shows a neighbour's photo with a very different stove.
parallelText.zh: 他笑着拿出邻居的照片，里面的炉子很不一样。

parallelText.en: We choose both photos instead of writing one simple rule about all older people.
parallelText.zh: 我们选择两张照片，而不为所有年长者写一条简单的统一规律。

parallelText.en: Before finishing, we add names and dates under the pictures.
parallelText.zh: 完成前，我们在图片下补上姓名和日期。

parallelText.en: Our page shows that people of a similar age can still have different lives.
parallelText.zh: 我们这一页显示，年龄相近的人也会有不同的生活。

passages.text: Aunt Lin hangs our homemade wind chime beside the balcony door. When the wind begins to blow, the short metal pieces touch and make soft sounds. However, a long ribbon wraps around them, and the sound stops. We need a solution that keeps the decoration but lets the pieces move freely. I fasten the ribbon to the top ring instead of leaving it between the pieces. The next breeze brings the sound back, and Aunt Lin asks me to explain the change. We draw the new arrangement so we can make another chime later.

parallelText.en: Aunt Lin hangs our homemade wind chime beside the balcony door.
parallelText.zh: 林阿姨把我们自制的风铃挂在阳台门旁。

parallelText.en: When the wind begins to blow, the short metal pieces touch and make soft sounds.
parallelText.zh: 风开始吹时，短金属片互相碰触，发出轻轻的声音。

parallelText.en: However, a long ribbon wraps around them, and the sound stops.
parallelText.zh: 然而，一根长丝带缠住金属片，声音停了。

parallelText.en: We need a solution that keeps the decoration but lets the pieces move freely.
parallelText.zh: 我们需要一个办法，既保留装饰，又让金属片自由移动。

parallelText.en: I fasten the ribbon to the top ring instead of leaving it between the pieces.
parallelText.zh: 我把丝带固定在顶环上，不再让它垂在金属片之间。

parallelText.en: The next breeze brings the sound back, and Aunt Lin asks me to explain the change.
parallelText.zh: 下一阵微风吹来，风铃又响了，林阿姨请我解释改动。

parallelText.en: We draw the new arrangement so we can make another chime later.
parallelText.zh: 我们画下新的布置，方便以后再做一个风铃。
